_comment: Guided tour for the Spectra Downloader (NavigationPanelTool): steps are panels of the left navigation list, and the user selects each one. Read by chisurf.gui.widgets.tools.guided_tour.

steps.title: A staging database, not the MMFDB
steps.text:
This tool fills a staging database of spectra from public sources — FPbase, Chroma, Thorlabs, PhotochemCAD, ATTO-TEC — and lets you look at it before anything reaches the MMFDB.

It computes nothing. R₀ is computed from the MMFDB by calc R0 in the TCSPC FRET models, once the spectra have been pushed there.

steps.title: What is already there
steps.text: Overview counts the staging database by category and by source. A source with zero rows has not been downloaded yet.

await.hint: Select Overview in the list on the left.

steps.title: Look at one component
steps.text:
Browse filters by name, source and category and shows one component's properties and spectra.

Check two things before using a dye for R₀: that it has an absorption spectrum (not only excitation), and that QY and Extinction are filled in — the spectra are peak-normalised, so without ε_max and Q_D there is no R₀.

await.hint: Select Browse, then type a dye name into the filter.

steps.title: Fetch a source
steps.text: Download runs one scraper into the staging database and shows its log. Only FPbase publishes an open data policy; treat the other sources as reference data for your own work.

steps.title: Push to the MMFDB
steps.text: Add to MMFDB chooses the target — a local MMFDB file or a server — and pushes the staging set. Pushed components arrive unverified; approve them in the MMFDB admin before relying on them.
